name: Brainstorming
description: Explore user intent, requirements and design before any creative work — creating features, building components, adding functionality, or modifying behavior.

promptPatterns: \b(brainstorm|头脑风暴|想想方案|讨论.*设计|explore.*idea)\b

commands.description: Explore intent and design before implementation
commands.injectPrompt: Apply the brainstorming skill: before implementing, explore the user's intent, clarify requirements, propose 2-3 design approaches with trade-offs, and converge on a direction before writing code.
